newsitem.title: USA: TABLE-Score Board Inc Q2 loss narrows.
newsitem.headline: TABLE-Score Board Inc Q2 loss narrows.

text.p: Three Months Ended Six Months Ended

NOTE: The company said it changed its fiscal year-end from January 31 to December 31. Second quarter and six months ended June 30, 1997, are compared to the second quarter and six months ended July 31, 1996.
Net income for the second quarter and first six months of 1996 includes extraordinary gain of $954,000, or $0.08 per share, from the early extinguishment of debt.

The company said the increase in weighted average shares is primarily a result of the issuance of shares in November 1996 in connection with a $4.0 million private equity placement led by T.L. Ventures, the venture capital management arm of Safeguard Scientifics Inc, and the issuance of 912,000 shares in connection with the retirement of $6.5 million of long-term debt.

Net income for the first six months of 1996 included a write-down of guaranteed payments under various entertainment license agreements. The company was not immediately available to discuss the amount of the write-down.
